prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the green stone terraces of Machu Picchu with stone steps of normal height and low terrace walls, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Lebanese person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a sleek male idol face with a straight nose, a sharp jawline, thick brows and cool intense eyes, a very faint trace of stubble, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, smooth olive-tan skin, a relaxed half-smile, cool ash-grey hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large silver hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a copper square-sided cowbell, a silver miniature anvil, a gold hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked silver anklets. Extremely long oval nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between every band. A thick short neck, huge round shoulders, an enormously deep chest, a thick powerful midsection with a solid belly, tree-trunk arms, and huge thick legs planted wide. RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif (a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense engraved floral facets filling the space between every band. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
